attacks.name: Psionic Barrage
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!wild| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make 1 additional |*Psionic Barrage| attack targeting the original target character. This additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Dragon of the Moon
steps: Add |!failure| results in the defender's roll to this attack's total successes.
|!wild| |*Hex|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§hex§Hex| special condition.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Distracting Illusions
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 3 makes an attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may used this superpower. This character rerolls 1 of the attacker's dice. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Shield Mind
superPowers.body: When this character or another allied character within |!range| 4 would be Advanced, Placed, or Pushed by the effect of an enemy |!mystic| attack or enemy superpower, this character may use this superpower. That character is not Advanced, Placed, or Pushed.

superPowers.name: Shao-Lom Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an attack targeting it from within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks results in its defense roll to its total successes.
